answers.reasoning: The lesson's own worked example says with no store change BearNames never settles: the fresh array fails Object.is every call until React throws Maximum update depth exceeded.
The lesson states create in v4 memoized the selection per snapshot (only unnecessary re-renders) and the v5 migration guide points to createWithEqualityFn from zustand/traditional for v4 behavior.
The shown source keeps prev in a ref and returns prev.current when shallow(prev.current, next) is true, otherwise stores and returns next, so the outer Object.is check sees the same reference.
shallow checks one level: A's nuts/honey values are unchanged so useShallow returns its previous array, but B's treats key gets a new spread reference so Object.is fails and only B re-renders.

The lesson says zustand does not track fields read and re-renders only by Object.is on the selected slice; an identity selector's slice is the whole state, which set replaces, but the reference itself doesn't loop since it's stable between sets.
